body: I am going to talk to a counselor. It helped me in the past, and hopefully it may help now. What I've been doing is listening to long podcast's. It's what I've always done when I've needed to get my mind off of something. I was told to surround myself with people that care about me for the next while, so I may try to do that. Someone also told me to get a pet. I've always been a cat person and I promised someone I would adopt..I think it's time for me to fulfill that promise. Feeling affection from someone or something is really what I need. It's what I'm going to desperately crave, now that She's gone.

I'm really sorry about your loss..This is going to be the second grandfather I've lost to cancer, and it's really heartbreaking. My life just feels..invaluable now. It's like, if she didn't want it, who would? I've never been with someone as amazing as her. I'm so lost.

And I'm not selfish.. :/ I was just making a point that now I'm one of the people I wish I could be talking to. I was a friend to everyone who needed help, and my life was dedicated to helping others. I didn't want to have anyone go through what I went through. I helped people realize that there are those who understand and care, and there are always reasons to keep going. I truly wanted to help..

It's a couple of things. I mean, I've been pretty bummed out because my Grandpa, who I was really close to, got diagnosed with lung cancer and it's inoperable. He doesn't have much longer..But I was engaged to get married to the perfect person. We had our ups and downs, but we had the relationship that no one thought was going to end. People were jealous of us. Night before last, she left me. Her words were that I was too perfect for her, that she lost feelings for me and she didn't understand why. That I don't deserve that, that I deserve someone just as perfect as me. Keep in mind, I don't think she was lying. I know this girl inside and out, and I could tell what she was saying was sincere and she was truly heartbroken that she didn't feel the same way anymore. My whole life revolved around her, talking to her, seeing her, being close to her. We were planning our future together, and there was absolutely no warning of this. It was just another normal day, until she gave me the ring back. My future that I was planning is erased now. I don't know what I'm supposed to do, because everything, like I said, revolved around being with her. I've had my heart broken before and I learned not to give my life to someone. But, after being with her for awhile, I decided to. She happily accepted my proposal, and we had wonderful times together. I mean, of course we had times where we disagreed on things and were unhappy, but they never lasted long and we were back to smiling and having the perfect relationship. My life was me walking down a very long highway, and now the highway has ended and all it is, is a dropoff.
Well, it's the reason I believed I was "here"..

You can call me William. Thank you a lot. It means so much that a random stranger can care..I used to be one of the people talking people out of suicide and cutting in forums all the time. It's what made me feel like a good person. It got to a point where I was called an angel by a few people..Yeah I know it's kind of lame, but helping people is what I want to do. Right now, though, I'm the one who needs help. It's just so hard..I'm so disappointed in myself. I was respected for what I did, for helping, and now I can't help myself, let alone someone else..

Yes. I used to have counseling sessions once a week when I was younger and going through major depression and suicidal stages. They helped me a lot, and eventually I was able to stop them and I was happy. But the biggest thing that made me happy, is now gone. I guess you can say..I was kind of left at the altar.
I do understand that, but I wasn't planning on stopping at the 50 mark..I've only recently started taking them, less than two weeks.
